reviews.text:
I have been bringing my cat to Wychwood Animal Hospital for many years for annual checkups. Always been happy with the service there.
Recently I had a medical emergency with my elderly cat. They got me in same day (twice in a week) and got her taken care of. I was treated with compassion from the staff that greeted me and Dr Levine listened to me through my tears. He explained the treatments he was going to do and how they work. He provided me with multiple options without pushing one way or another. I opted for a more expensive blood test for my own sanity.
I truly believe not every vet would have been so compassionate and willing to treat a 15 year old cat. I’m happy to say she’s back to normal and I believe Dr Levine saved my best friend
Thank you

Ive seen Dr. Mike Levine for multiple cats and he provides the best of care. If there are any issues or concerns, he is very quick to address them and make you and your pet feel comfortable.
I recently brought my cat in for a check up. I informed the Doctor she can be a little temperamental. He handled her so well. Our cat was relatively calm the whole time and did amazing with her shots. We really thought she'd be a little trouble for the Doctor but no problem.
Very professional and caring.

I’m pretty disappointed with the service we received recently.  We brought our 1st dog’s remains here two years ago and we were given proper and cost effective options on how to deal with her cremation.  This time around we had to put our 2nd dog to sleep and the options given were alot higher (and I am not talking about what is needed for the procedure, as the first dog had already passed on by the time we brought her in) and we were told the option we were looking for (ink plaque) was not available.  Given the dogs condition, I did not have the heart to take her home to shop around and just paid the options given.  I took a look at Gateway’s website and what we have for the 1st dog and wanted is still up.  I definitely do not recommend coming here if you are looking for end of life options for your pet

I've recently been taking my new cat Murdoch to Wychwood Park Animal Hospital and it's been great! Dr. Levine, and more recently Dr. Karen MacMillan, have been super helpful with a general checkup and also monitoring Murdoch's ear infection. I've found that they're very knowledgeable and friendly, and I'm able to get an appointment when needed. The front desk staff have also been impressive - getting all of our files correct and coordinating appointments based on feedback from the vets. Highly recommend.

I was robbed blind repeatedly even though I asked politely no to be. Told to drop my sick cat off for a couple of hours and was met with thousands of dollars in bills never once run by me ahead of time. Now that I've been to a good vet I realize how badly I was scammed. I'm sorry.

We love Dr. Mike Levine and the team at Wychwood Animal Park Hospital.  Dr. Levine offers very practical advice and takes the time to explain all the treatment options available to your pet. I have since moved further away from his clinic but I will always make the trip to bring my dog to him.  Wychwood Animal Park Hospital is one of the few remaining independently own vet clinics in the city and I will always support it.
I trust them with my cat Emmerson, and that is as much as I can ask for.
Dr Levine and staff are great.
The staff especially the doctor. The doctor very friendly and knowledgeable. I would definitely recommend

Horrible several experiences. Treatment rooms are often filled with fur and don’t feel cleaned, I have waited over an hour for a scheduled appointment, and it feels like the vet doesn’t actually care about animals

Dr. Mike and team are absolute experts at what they do. It's so clear how much they care about their patients and the owners too! My pup had her teeth cleaned here and what could have been a very stressful and expensive appointment was made more comfortable by the team calling and checking in, while also being realistic about overall costs. While teeth cleaning is always going to be expensive, the team at Wychwood Park try to be as accommodating as possible. Thanks all!

Doctor Michael Levine is an incredible Veterinarian!!! His  attention to detail and years of experience, on top of his beautiful care and dedication, makes our visits with our puppy, feel so wonderful and so well taken care of and very looked after. The staff are very professional and personable.  We wouldn't take our puppy anywhere else, but to Wychwood Park Animal Hospital. We highly highly recommend the amazing Doctor Michael Levine!!! 🙏🐾🐾🙏🥰

These folks listen to the animal as well as the human, don't treat the human like a walking wallet, and do miracles with our fur friends.  I walked in worried about my furry overlady.  Dr Mike examined her, said she was fine, and asked what I wanted. Her old vet would have prescribed expensive tests and drugs.

I said "Tell me if I am over-reacting." He gently said "You're over-reacting. But monitor her for a few days and if it doesn't improve, bring her back." It improved on its own. No expensive tests, no expensive meds. Just a caring vet who isn't in it for how much he can fleece from his patients' families!

Dr. Mike and his team have been so wonderful to my pup and to me. As a new dog owner I didn’t know what to expect. He walked me through the vaccines and appts I would need to keep my dog healthy. He is sweet, kind and incredibly helpful. His staff is friendly and make it easy to make an appt or answer any questions I may have. Thank you Dr. Mike and Wychwood Park Animal Hospital.
Limited knowledge on species other than dogs and cats

It’s very difficult to book appointments due to the hours of service, the volume of people, and the lack of availability. Dr. Mike is often on vacation. Staff members don’t know what’s going on and in my experience are often insensitive towards owners/customers.  Dr. Mike Levine missed a small tumor in my dogs body, and eventually my dog passed away. My dog could have been saved if i had been at my current vet, for my new pet. They are much more professional, sensitive, kind, organized, knowledgeable, professional, and want to help.
Dr. Mike and the entire staff at Wychwood park are always so friendly and helpful to us and our dog. Would always recommend to family and friends!

We have been exceedingly happy with the whole team at Wychwood. For the past three years, they have taken great care of our two cats, whenever necessary. As both cats were older, they often required last-minute and urgent care, and the team at Wychwood always tried their best to accomodate us. When we recently had a dental emergency, they were incredibly supportive, and when we needed last-minute documentations for travel, we got that immediately.

Dr Levine and the team also were amazing when one of our cats unfortunately had to be put to sleep - she was old (17) and had end-stage kidney failure. Dr Levine reassured us about the procedure, and we got all the time we needed with our cat after she had passed. They also made a donation in her name. We felt that she was well cared for and had as good an end to her life as possible.

We are sad to leave this amazing practice behind, but we would highly recommend it to anyone in the neighborhood.

I want to give a huge thank you to Char for all her incredible help and support during a very stressful time. I was preparing to travel from Canada to Russia with my pets flying in the cabin — with a layover in Egypt — and the paperwork process for CFIA was overwhelming. Char went above and beyond to guide me through every step, making sure I had all the correct documents and requirements. Her kindness, patience, and attention to detail made a world of difference. Thanks to her, everything went smoothly and we made it safely. She’s not only a great professional, but also a genuinely caring person. I’m so grateful!
Friendly receptionists, the Vet is so chill and easy to talk to. Happy I found him
Friendly and knowledgeable. Easy to book an appointment and flexible with changes.
Very helpful and caring staff.

Great experience bringing in my newly adopted cat Waldo! Dr. Levine caught an ear infection that previous vets had not and gave me drops that cleared it up within days. Additionally, he was sure to let me know what other procedures were necessary/ not necessary according to my budget. Overall the visit was less than I expected :) will definitely be back
Very helpful and caring practice.

I was able to book an appointment for a new client (my cat) on fairly short notice (2 business days).  The clinic staff were friendly & helpful, Dr. Levine was great with my cat, and the whole visit was more affordable than I had feared. I left the appointment with a smile on my face, and gratitude in my heart. An excellent veterinary medicine experience!

This is a great vet!! The front desk people are so lovely, patient and kind. The doc was also very knowledgeable and friendly. They do not push you to do things/buy tests that are unnecessary (a lot of vets i’ve been to do this which is annoying). I look forward to bringing my dog back here again! Big thanks to the staff from myself and my dog Billy!😊
Excellent vet
We've been taking our dog here for years and have had wonderful service. Highly recommend.

Dr Levine and the techs are all fa wonderful. They never upsell on procedures or  medications and will often tell you that you can pick up some meds for cheaper at the drug store rather than buy from the vet. The only vet my cat tolerates.

This is an exceptional clinic . I love the way how they care about our pets . The price are reasonable,  very helpful,  I have been raccomanding this clinic to all the people that I know . Highly racomanded

I can’t say enough good things about this clinic. They are truly fantastic — compassionate, kind, and dedicated to both animals and their owners. When I faced the heartbreaking decision to put down one of my beloved pets, the team went above and beyond to provide warmth and support. Their kindness made an incredibly difficult process just a little more bearable, and I will always be grateful for the care they showed during that time.

Since then, I’ve continued bringing my other cats here, and the quality of care remains outstanding. They are thorough, attentive, and always take the time to ensure my pets are comfortable and well-cared for. This clinic is a rare gem, and I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a team that truly loves what they do. Thank you for everything!

It's always a pleasure to vist Dr.Levine and staff with my cat Angel, I'll start this by saying just how much I trust them.

Across the last couple months I've unfortunately had the need to get some blood work done for my pet, but the staff took very good care of her. From a rather well explained diagnosis, to speedy meds to the wonderful vet techs and staff he has the experience is superb. Definitely helped put me at ease when the potential for worms was brought up.

Aside from the one offs, I also get the regular check ups and yearly cat vaccines done here and I've always been pleasantly surprised with both how easy, quick and seem less this process is. Would highly recommend!
Compassionate, caring, and informative people work here. They help take great care of my dog
Lovely staff, Dr. Mike is so gentle and kind with our little elderly dog.
Care about your pets. Even checked up to see how Mr Kitty was doing.
